name: Speak with Renferrel
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons.  He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, very good. There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 11 to 15, 2,565 XP in all.

quests.name: Escorting Erland
quests.objectiveText: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.

quests.name: The Deathstalkers' Report
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Speak with Renferrel
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Zinge's Delivery
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

quests.name: Sample for Helbrim
